placement.classification: NODD DESIGN CHOICE — new unsigned numerical fixtures, approving humans pending
placement.description: Flat uses physical trial-body pitches and no staggering. Staggered uses active pitches and four alternating normal levels, half-pitch phi row shifts and quarter-of-overlap longitudinal/radial parity shifts. Tilted adds 12-degree rotation about local meridional axis; pint inclined normals stay as prescribed (no additional tilt there). Hybrid uses flat cylindrical barrels and staggered discs/inclined rings. No cropping at ideal or host boundaries.
placement.clearance_rationale: Additional clearance variants preserve controls; pixel discs use 4 phi colours times2 radial parity (8levels), phi counts rounded to colorperiod. Barrel spacing >= body thickness +2*(sqrt(r²+(body_u/2)²)-r)+0.2mm, conservative curvature shell separation. Same active dimensions, no added tilt; complete OBB SAT still required.

review_placement.classification: NODD DESIGN CHOICE; PR24 expert direction plus explicit numerical clearance hypotheses, formal sign-off pending
review_placement.endcaps: Retain hybrid_clearance endcap tiling: 4 phi x2 radial levels for pixels; 2 phi x2 radial levels for strips; no additional local tilt.
interpretations: The third unnamed barrel bullet means long strips.
No tilt section means no pint inclined barrel-end sections, not prohibition of local rphi module tilts.
review_placement.clearance_rationale: Tangential phi staggering uses two radial shells. Tilted phi staggering uses common radius across phi, so the shingle tilt provides the staggering. No-z staves keep phi/radius/tilt fixed along z and use at least occupied-body length+0.2mm pitch. Z-staggered rows retain half-phi-pitch alternation, alternating radial row levels and quarter-overlap longitudinal column shifts. For radial levels define H=body_u/2*abs(sin tilt)+body_w/2*abs(cos tilt), T=body_u/2*abs(cos tilt)+body_w/2*abs(sin tilt); spacing=max(inherited spacing,2H+2*(hypot(radius,T)-radius)+0.2mm). This bounds tilted-body radial projection and curvature, not fitted coverage. The 12 degree angle and 0.2 mm clearance are inherited trial values; complete 3D OBB SAT and host checks remain mandatory.
review_placement.row_fit_rationale: For no-z staggering use N=floor((nominal_span-active_bounding_height)/(body_height+clearance))+1, then uniform pitch=(nominal_span-active_bounding_height)/(N-1). This is the maximum full-module row count whose bodies clear while unrotated active endpoints fit the unchanged nominal barrel ends. Actual stereo/body overhang is separately reported. A fixed_body_pitch_cover control uses ceil+1 and minimum pitch, retaining the rejected long-barrel/endcap collision example. Neither clips modules or overlaps bodies to hide dead seams.
